input_usuario: Qual o valor total de contratos assinados em 2025?
query_referencia: SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_contrato AS DECIMAL)) AS total FROM contrato_contratos WHERE ano_referencia = 2025 AND CAST(cod_orgao AS INTEGER) IN (2, 4, 5);
query_gerada: SELECT SUM(CAST(c.vlr_contrato AS DECIMAL)) AS total_contratos FROM contrato_contratos c WHERE c.ano_referencia = 2025 AND c.vlr_contrato > 0;
